value.body: A three-year surgical MS after MBBS covering bones, joints, muscles and the spine — fractures and trauma, joint replacement, sports injuries, paediatric orthopaedics and spine surgery. Training is hands-on, in operation theatres and emergency departments.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: MBBS with a completed internship and NMC/State Medical Council registration. Admission is through NEET-PG; seats are filled by MCC counselling (All-India quota, central and deemed universities) and by state counselling. DNB Orthopaedics through NBEMS is a parallel route.

value.title: At a glance
items: Trauma care means night emergencies and long theatre days, especially during residency.
Independent practice needs theatre access and equipment; many surgeons work in hospitals for years first.
Fellowships in joint replacement, arthroscopy/sports or spine surgery are common next steps.
